issues.description: Method return-type mismatch for PersonService.addParent(Person, Person): The problem statement (lines 99-106) and the template implementation declare and describe PersonService.addParent(...) as returning a Person (the saved/updated entity). PersonResource (both template and solution) and the tests invoke the method and assign its result (e.g., person = personService.addParent(...)). In the solution repository, PersonService.addParent(...) is implemented with return type void (signature: public void addParent(Person person, Person parent)), which conflicts with the expected return type. This mismatch will cause compilation errors at the call sites (PersonResource and tests) and prevents students from running the provided tests or using the controller as documented.
